target_customer: Ecommerce and on-demand retailers (originally) and now AI agent builders and data teams needing web data
problem: Retailers needed competitor pricing and product data from websites that are hard to scrape. Anakin first sold pricing intelligence and now sells a web data API for AI agents.
business_model: usage-based credits and subscription API (Free, $19, $100 and enterprise tiers); earlier B2B SaaS pricing intelligence
product_category: web data API and pricing intelligence

founders.name: Mohit Prateek
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch December 2021 says he worked on pricing at Flipkart, then started other companies.

founders.name: Rashmi Bala
founders.background_notes: Employers from TechCrunch, education from the YC page.

competitors.name: Intelligence Node
competitors.what: Pricing monitoring and digital shelf analytics for retail

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable scraping at scale across thousands of sites with anti-bot defenses and structured extraction is real engineering, but not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Scraping tooling is copyable and the AI-agent data market is crowded (Firecrawl is named as the closest peer); data coverage and cost are the edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pricing intelligence incumbents persisted; Anakin repositioned toward AI-agent web data and remained independent in 2026.

market_need_then: Ecommerce retailers were paying for competitor price monitoring; TechCrunch reported revenue growing 24 percent per month and profitability before the seed round.

branding.domain_note: Now uses anakin.io; a separate product named Anakin AI exists and the company's FAQ addresses the difference (answer not seen).

identity.voice_and_tone: terse and technical (One API. The whole web.)

branding.community_and_virality: Open-source scraping engine on GitHub (AGPL-3.0) and developer blog posts; no merch or fan content found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name echoes Star Wars and overlaps with another Anakin AI product; limited brand-specific coverage.

pivots.from: pricing intelligence for ecommerce and on-demand companies
pivots.to: web data API for AI agents (Anakin.io)
pivots.why: Packaged the scraping infrastructure for AI agents; exact date not stated by sources.

outcome_analysis: Anakin began as a profitable pricing intelligence business and raised a $2M seed in December 2021 from YC and others. It later repositioned its scraping infrastructure as a web data API for AI agents and now lists a team of about 70 in Austin. It remains active with no exit; its current competitive set is fast moving.
notes: Seed amount corroborated by TechCrunch and aggregators (Seedtable, SaaS News). CB Insights shows $2.13M total across two rounds; second round not identified. Pivot date uncertain; everydev profile says the infrastructure was later packaged as Anakin.io. Competera source has no visible date; Intelligence Node funding is from an aggregator. HQ conflicts (YC Austin, TechCrunch San Francisco, Latka Singapore). Confidence high is claimed on founders, funding and competitor sets sourced, but competitor evidence is thin.
